calls.title: Ryan / Matthew
calls.summary: The discussion focused on enhancing outreach strategies targeting former users and event-based leads to boost engagement and conversion rates. Specifically, the team is refining contact finder expansion to reach individuals who changed companies, implementing improved messaging tailored to product managers, and establishing a rapid meeting scheduling process to maximize conversions. They are also exploring targeted outreach towards heavy Pro users to facilitate upgrades to Enterprise accounts, acknowledging challenges with pricing and packaging. Additionally, the conversation highlighted significant data quality issues affecting outreach effectiveness, leading to plans for reviewing alternative data providers. Enhanced team coordination and transparency in documentation were emphasized to streamline processes and improve results.
calls.keywords: Growth Marketing, Outbound Campaigns, Contact Finder, Pro to Enterprise Upgrade, Event Outreach, Data Quality
